customManagers.description: The wrangler pin in container-build.yml (global edge) and steward-deploy.yml (steward edges): one regex, so one PR moves both.

packageRules.description: Nightly: everything the builder does not load (Actions, Docker, tool pins, the SPA's deps), none of which changes the built catalog bytes. No minimum release age anywhere (repo policy); this also lifts config:recommended's npm delay.
Weekly: what the builder loads, every Cargo manifest.
prBodyNotes: Merges on green CI; the next curation real-seed build proves it (no standalone proof build).

packageRules.description: Its own weekly PR refreshing the lockfiles (Cargo.lock among them). The group name only keeps all lockfiles in that one branch.

packageRules.description: Hold: the SPA's `typescript` is only openapi-typescript's peer (gen:types), which needs the JS compiler API that TypeScript 7 dropped. Type checking uses `@typescript/native` (TS 7), which this rule does not match. Drop when openapi-typescript supports TS 7.
